relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: It has been reported that TNF-α blocks the activation of eNOS through the degradation of eNOS mRNA and by interfering with the phosphorylation of protein kinase Akt [35].

relationships.subject: Adiponectin
relationships.evidence_quote: adiponectin, an inflammatory mediator secreted by adipose tissue, stimulates EPC migration and tube formation through activation of VEGF expression facilitated by MEK/ERK signaling

relationships.subject: Infliximab
relationships.evidence_quote: infliximab, a chimeric antibody targeted against TNF-α, improved the numbers and functional properties of EPCs

relationships.subject: Fibroblasts
relationships.evidence_quote: Fibroblast activation and proliferation may adopt pro-inflammatory and tissue invasive functions by releasing metalloproteinases (MMPs)

key_findings: Review: EPC number and function are altered in rheumatoid arthritis, with conflicting reports; TNF-alpha, ROS and NO/eNOS impairment influence EPCs.
VEGF is excessively expressed in RA synovium and drives neovascularization and EPC homing.
